value.rationale: The sharp all-size bound and exact equal-mean two-reversal witness answer a specific movement-model interpretability question motivated by the 2024 time-conditioned habitat selection framework and observed sampling-frequency connectivity artifacts. Destination-only habitat qualities cannot change circulation direction, while sampling interval alone may produce a false direction sequence; a common-rate Gamma model has a sharp contrasting one-reversal ceiling. The fact is not inferred from a finite census and does not claim animal-level field prediction.
